name: Two-colourings without a monochromatic 3-cube (rediscovering R(Q3,Q3) = 13)
description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'colors': [...]}: colour 0 or 1 for each pair (i,j), i<j, of vertices 0..n-1 in lexicographic order, 1 <= n <= 13. Neither colour class may contain the 8-vertex cube graph Q3 as a subgraph. Maximize n; the proven optimum is 12. Recovering a 12-vertex colouring with no monochromatic Q3 rediscovers the extremal lower bound.
